只有你在确认弹窗中点击发送，App 才会发送评分照片。弹窗说明模型、张数和照片类: The app sends scoring photos only after you tap send in the confirmation dialog. The dialog states the model, photo count, and photo type; the current provider, model, and preview size stay visible in the sidebar AI Scoring section.
本轮：输入 %lld tokens，输出 %lld tokens。费用以所选供应: This run: %1$lld input tokens and %2$lld output tokens. See the selected provider's bill for cost.
每次请求发送 2–5 张同类型照片的匿名 JPEG 预览；最长边由你选择为小 5: Each request sends 2–5 anonymous JPEG previews of photos of the same type. You choose the longest edge: Small 512px, Medium 1024px, or Large 1536px. Originals, filenames, local paths, and EXIF/GPS are never sent.
需要 API Key 吗: Do I need an API key?
不需要也能用：本地筛选、相似分组、技术风险提示和导出都不依赖 AI。配置 Key: No. Local curation, similarity grouping, technical risk flags, and export all work without AI. Adding a key enables AI Scoring, which stays optional.
保留至少一张照片就可以导出，导出多少由你决定；保留目标只用于显示进度，不构成限制: Keep at least one photo and you can export. How many you export is up to you; the keep target only shows progress and is not a limit.
费用以你所选供应商的账单为准，App 不销售也不代充额度。预览尺寸越大，上传量、: Charges follow the bill from the provider you selected; the app neither sells nor tops up credit. Larger previews mean more upload, longer waits, and higher cost.
其他会联网的操作: Other actions that use the network
“验证并保存”和“验证已保存的 Key”会向所选模型发送 1 张内置测试图，测试: “Verify and save” and “Verify saved key” send one built-in test image to the selected model; the test image never comes from your photos. “Refresh account models” only reads the model IDs visible to your OpenAI / Anthropic account — it sends no images and stores no model list. Both happen only when you click them.
切换到风景并评分: Switch to scenery and score it
在左侧“AI评分”里点击“开始人物 AI评分”，并在确认框中继续。使用内置结果，: In the sidebar under AI Scoring, click “Start people AI scoring” and continue in the confirmation dialog. It uses built-in results and never goes online.
在“照片类型”中选择“风景”，再点左侧“开始风景 AI评分”。两类分别评分、分别: Choose Scenery under Photo type, then click “Start scenery AI scoring” in the sidebar. Each type is scored and ranked separately.
选中一张已评分的照片，点底部“查看评分”；看过总分与五维评价后关掉大图即可。: Select a scored photo and click “View score” at the bottom. Read the total and the five dimensions, then close the large view.
网格已切到“已AI评分”，按分数逐张看过后，用底部的“采纳”确认。: The grid is already on AI-scored. Review them in score order, then confirm with “Accept” at the bottom.
风景照片已单独显示。现在在左侧点击“开始风景 AI评分”。: Scenery photos are now shown on their own. Click “Start scenery AI scoring” in the sidebar.
人工决定已保留。下一步在左侧“AI评分”里点击“开始人物 AI评分”。: Kept by your own decision. Next, click “Start people AI scoring” in the sidebar under AI Scoring.
离线示例：用内置结果为 %lld 张%@照片打分，不联网、不读取 Keychai: Offline sample: scoring %1$lld %2$@ photos with built-in results. No network, no Keychain access, no credit used.
在“照片类型”中选择“人物”。人物和风景分开整理，也分开评分。: Choose People under Photo type. People and scenery are curated separately and scored separately.
点底部“采纳”。被采纳的照片就成为“保留”，导出时会被复制出去；最终决定始终由你: Click Accept at the bottom. Accepted photos become Keep and are copied on export. The final call is always yours.
同样点底部“采纳”，把风景结果也变成保留。: Click Accept again to turn the scenery results into keeps.
你已经完成本地分析、AI评分、采纳确认和复制导出。点击“结束新手引导”返回。: You have completed local analysis, AI scoring, acceptance, and export. Click Finish tutorial to return.
人物照片已单独显示。现在在左侧点击“开始人物 AI评分”。: People photos are now shown on their own. Click “Start people AI scoring” in the sidebar.
评分只提供解释和排序。点底部的“采纳”，被采纳的照片就成为保留。: Scores only explain and rank. Click Accept at the bottom and the accepted photos become keeps.
本地分析完成：4 张人物、4 张风景，各保留 2 张。现在在“照片类型”中选择“: Local analysis is done: 4 people photos and 4 scenery photos, keeping 2 of each. Now choose People under Photo type.
人物离线评分完成。打开任意一张照片，用底部的“查看评分”看它为什么得这个分。: Offline scoring for people is done. Open any photo and use “View score” at the bottom to see why it scored that way.
风景离线评分完成。点底部的“采纳”，把风景结果也变成保留。: Offline scoring for scenery is done. Click Accept at the bottom to turn those results into keeps.
分开人物和风景、找出相似照片、标出技术风险: Separating people from scenery, grouping near-duplicates, flagging technical risks
真实文件夹越大这一步越久，导入照片后就是从这里开始。: The bigger the real folder, the longer this takes — every import starts here.
正在本地分析示例照片；完成后就能开始筛选。: Analyzing the sample photos locally. Curation starts as soon as this finishes.
